verdict.rationale: Attio's docs say its data model lets you define custom objects and lists with a wide array of attribute types, beyond the default people/companies and optional deals. Marketing pages promise custom objects, customizable fields, and linking objects in a graph model. The REST API lists both system-defined and user-defined objects, and the OpenAPI spec covers object endpoints. missing for 10: detailed docs on relationship/record-reference attributes (only marketing copy), explicit evidence of creating objects and attributes programmatically via API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
